scope: Independent offline audit of a completed native-arm64 console allocation on an Apple virtual machine; no AU/VST3/CoreAudio/DAW or physical-device acceptance.
limitations: Per-stage timings include tracing overhead; the compiled-out and enabled arms quantify observer sensitivity, not a proposed DSP fix.
Thread CPU is not DSP-only time. Wall minus CPU is not an exclusive scheduling, hypervisor or cache-stall measurement; raw CPU greater than wall is retained.
Stage durations are inclusive. Parent and child costs must not be summed; exemplars show immediate-child-subtracted wall remainders only, still including boundary overhead.
TASK_EVENTS_INFO faults/pageins are process-wide and may include the IR worker and recorder. Missing thread fault/switch and hardware-cache metrics remain unavailable.
The archive contains reported executable fingerprints, not executables. Fingerprint consistency can be independently checked; binary contents cannot be rehashed from this artifact.
Worker-present arms have asynchronous realized publication exposure; requested schedules alone do not establish equal executed workloads.
All raw misses remain in the immutable artifact and combined native-deadline-misses.csv; no population is replaced by a better rerun.

source_and_build_binding.binary_hash_scope: Consistency of immutable receipts only; executable files are absent from artifact, so their bytes are not independently rehashed.

producer_report_receipt.scope: Full original producer report retained in the immutable raw artifact. The bounded audit reproduces independent verifier decisions and callback statistics rather than embedding the 2 MB producer summary.

pooled_quantiles_scope: Mode-level wall and thread_cpu quantiles in populations[].modes[] pool the registered engine/channel routes. They are descriptive inventory only, not route acceptance results or a comparable DSP distribution. Interpret timing per engine/channel route and phase; per-route and per-phase statistics are preserved unchanged.
